drhp.business: The company is engaged in the business of fluid handling - from supply of pumps to turnkey project execution. It supplies a comprehensive range of pumps to the industrial, municipal and irrigation sector, selling directly to customers as well as through agents and dealers, and also has a strong project division which undertakes water management contracts in those sectors. Operations are organised as a domestic Product Division (assembled-to-order and engineered-to-order pumps) and a Project Division, alongside international pump and project businesses in Italy, South Africa, Australia and …

risks.note: Management calls this the biggest concern: 'The biggest concern remains geo political risks especially with the breakdown of global trade and the impact of rising energy costs on global economies. This would have a negative effect on investment in public infrastructure.' The ongoing war between US and Iran and Middle East tensions are said to have adversely impacted global economies and the sentiments of all economies worldwide, making it imperative for the Company to prepare for volatility in its global markets.
risks.risk: Geopolitical conflict and breakdown of global trade

risks.note: The move away from globalisation towards a tariff-based global economy is expected to dent the flow in global trade further and lead to inflationary spikes and recessionary pressures, with global GDP growth assumptions already tempered down. This matters because international operations are now a large part of the business and globalisation initiatives are giving way to bilateral/multilateral trade blocs.
risks.risk: De-globalisation and a tariff-based global economy

risks.note: Project division revenues were majorly affected due to sector constraints, and the outlook is explicitly tied to the approval of Jal Jeevan Mission 2 with enhanced outlay leading to release of central funds, new tender announcements and visibility on outstanding dues. Scheme timing therefore drives both revenue and receivable realisation.
risks.risk: Dependence on government-funded water programmes for the domestic project division

risks.note: The division's performance depends on completion and commissioning of existing projects, with more commissionings expected only in the first half of FY2027 and improved performance guided to the latter half of FY2027; slippage in execution directly delays revenue and the O&M annuity that follows commissioning.
risks.risk: Project execution and commissioning timing risk

risks.note: The conflicts have resulted in sharp increase in energy prices, inflation and supply chain disruption globally, the impact of which were significant in India as well - a direct input-cost and delivery risk for a pump manufacturer and turnkey contractor.
risks.risk: Energy cost inflation and supply-chain disruption

risks.note: Operations span Italy (Gruppo Aturia, MISA), South Africa, Zambia and Botswana, Australia (Sterling Pumps, United Pumps) and Thailand, plus MENA exports; the BRSR shows the great majority of subsidiaries, joint venture and associates are incorporated outside India, so currency, country and end-market cycles in several jurisdictions feed the consolidated result.

The BRSR material-issues table flags 'Regulatory issues and compliance' as a risk with negative financial implication - non-compliance may impact brand image and customer trust and engagement - and 'Business ethics' as a risk that may impact the image of the entity and the trust of stakeholders, mitigated by a compliance monitoring system, the WPIL code of conduct and the Whistle Blower Policy.

The BRSR flags Health & Safety as a risk that may directly impact the workforce and community and disrupt the operation, and Human Rights & labour conditions as a risk that must be ensured for seamless operations; the BRSR turnover table also shows the permanent-employee attrition rate rising versus each of the two preceding financial years, a retention risk for an engineering-led business.
risks.risk: Health & safety, human rights and workforce retention
